主要内容: On June 19, 2012, The Industrial Development Authority of the County of Pima issued and sold $16,465,000 aggregate principal amount of tax-exempt industrial development revenue bonds for the benefit of Tucson Electric Power Company. The bonds bear interest at a fixed rate of 4.50%, payable semi-annually on June 1 and December 1 of each year, commencing December 1, 2012, and mature on June 1, 2030. The bonds are payable from TEP's loan agreement with the Authority, which has loaned the proceeds to TEP. TEP is obligated to make payments to cover principal, premium, and interest on the bonds. The bonds are unsecured. Proceeds from the sale of the bonds, along with TEP's funds, will redeem $16,465,000 in tax-exempt bonds with interest rates of 5.85% and 5.875%, maturing between 2026 and 2033.
